objects.name: role_note_pulse_zh
objects.text: 用鼓点的不同附和方式，把你的节奏衬托起来。

objects.name: role_note_dust_zh
objects.text: 让敲击生出颗粒与余韵。

objects.name: role_note_harmony_zh
objects.text: 以短奏、分解和小句附和。

objects.name: role_note_pulse_en
objects.text: Layered drum support around your rhythm.

objects.name: role_note_voice_en
objects.text: Your rhythm, given a melodic voice.

objects.name: role_note_dust_en
objects.text: Small grains and trails around your taps.

objects.name: role_note_harmony_en
objects.text: Short chords, broken notes and replies.

objects.name: display_note_1
objects.font_charset: 屏幕保持设定的亮度。亮度调整未成功，请再试一次。

objects.name: display_note_1_en
objects.text: Brightness stays at your chosen level.
objects.font_charset: Brightness stays at your chosen level.Could not set brightness. Please try again.

objects.name: guide_body_0_0
objects.text: 轻点屏幕中央，试试这个角色的声音。
objects.font_charset: 轻点屏幕中央，试试这个角色的声音。

objects.name: guide_body_0_1
objects.text: 到“角色”里，还能换一种声音。
objects.font_charset: 到“角色”里，还能换一种声音。

objects.name: guide_body_1_0
objects.text: 点“录制”，等倒数结束后再敲。
objects.font_charset: 点“录制”，等倒数结束后再敲。

objects.name: guide_body_1_1
objects.text: 录制共四拍，结束后会回放一次。
objects.font_charset: 录制共四拍，结束后会回放一次。

objects.name: guide_body_2_0
objects.text: 点“播放”循环，点“暂停”停下。
objects.font_charset: 点“播放”循环，点“暂停”停下。

objects.name: guide_body_2_1
objects.text: 想听哪台，就点那台的“播放”。
objects.font_charset: 想听哪台，就点那台的“播放”。

objects.name: guide_body_3_0
objects.text: 再找一台装好 Echoy 的 Mosaico
objects.font_charset: 再找一台装好 Echoy 的 Mosaico

objects.name: guide_body_3_1
objects.text: 同朝向贴到右侧，最多支持三台。
objects.font_charset: 同朝向贴到右侧，最多支持三台。

objects.name: guide_body_0_0_en
objects.text: Tap the center to try this role’s sound.
objects.font_charset: Tap the center to try this role’s sound.

objects.name: guide_body_0_1_en
objects.text: Open Role to choose a different sound.
objects.font_charset: Open Role to choose a different sound.

objects.name: guide_body_1_0_en
objects.text: Tap Record. Wait for the countdown, then tap.
objects.font_charset: Tap Record. Wait for the countdown, then tap.

objects.name: guide_body_1_1_en
objects.text: You have 4 beats. Your rhythm plays back once.
objects.font_charset: You have 4 beats. Your rhythm plays back once.

objects.name: guide_body_2_0_en
objects.text: Tap Play to repeat your rhythm; Pause to stop.
objects.font_charset: Tap Play to repeat your rhythm; Pause to stop.

objects.name: guide_body_2_1_en
objects.text: Tap Play on each tile you want to hear.
objects.font_charset: Tap Play on each tile you want to hear.

objects.name: guide_body_3_0_en
objects.text: Put another Mosaico running Echoy on the right.
objects.font_charset: Put another Mosaico running Echoy on the right.

objects.name: guide_body_3_1_en
objects.text: Face both the same way. Connect up to 3 tiles.
objects.font_charset: Face both the same way. Connect up to 3 tiles.
